name: @protoforge/keeper
description: ProtoForge Secret Management System - The paranoid bouncer between agents and secrets

scripts.init-vault: node -e "const Vault = require('./vault'); const v = new Vault(); v.initialize().then(() => console.log('Vault initialized'));"
scripts.rotate-secrets: node -e "const Vault = require('./vault'); const v = new Vault(); v.initialize().then(() => { console.log('Checking rotation...'); v.list().forEach(k => console.log(k, v.needsRotation(k) ? 'NEEDS ROTATION' : 'OK')); })"

author: ProtoForge
